newsitem.title: USA: US OPTIONS FOCUS/Apple puts, calls busy on selloff.
newsitem.headline: US OPTIONS FOCUS/Apple puts, calls busy on selloff.

text.p: Options on shares of Apple Computer Inc drew heavy activity Monday as the stock fell sharply in active trade.
"There's lots of speculation on both sides, puts and calls," said Andrew Schwarz, senior partner at AGS Specialist Partners. "That led to a pretty good expansion in volatility."
He said front-month volatilities rose to slightly higher than 55 from around the 45 region.
By about 1000 CST/1600 GMT, Apple shares were down 3-5/8 at 18-1/8 on more than 10.5 million shares.
The computer maker's stock fell to an early session low of 17-1/4 before recovering.

The stock fell after the company said late Friday that weak demand for its Performa line of personal computers would lead to an operating loss of $100 million to $150 million in the first quarter ended in December.
Monday morning, Prudential Securities and Bear Stearns cut their investment ratings on Apple and Lehman Brothers lowered its fiscal first quarter earnings estimate.
"There are some bulls and bears in Apple," Schwarz said of the options trading. AGS is the specialist for Apple options.
Options activity was led by the April 20 call, which traded nearly 1,600 contracts by 1015 CST/1615 GMT. The option, which had open interest through Friday of 1,205, fell two to 1-3/4.

Other busy Apple options included the January 20 call, which traded about 730 contracts, the January 20 put, which traded 620, the January 25 call, which traded 405, and the January 17-1/2 put, which traded 550.
